# stonebranch_task_workflow (Resource)

Manages a StoneBranch Workflow Task. Workflow tasks orchestrate the execution of multiple tasks in a defined sequence with dependencies.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Stonebranch Workflow Task Example
#
# This example demonstrates how to create workflow task resources in Stonebranch.
# Workflow tasks orchestrate the execution of multiple tasks in sequence.
#
# Note: Tasks within the workflow (vertices) and their dependencies (edges) are
# typically managed through the StoneBranch UI after the workflow is created.
#
# Usage:
#   export STONEBRANCH_API_TOKEN="your-token"
#   terraform init
#   terraform plan
#   terraform apply

terraform {
  required_providers {
    stonebranch = {
      source = "stonebranch/stonebranch"
    }
  }
}

provider "stonebranch" {
  # Uses STONEBRANCH_API_TOKEN environment variable
}

# Simple workflow
resource "stonebranch_task_workflow" "simple" {
  name    = "tf-example-simple-workflow"
  summary = "A simple workflow for demonstration"
}

# Workflow with critical path calculation
resource "stonebranch_task_workflow" "with_critical_path" {
  name                    = "tf-example-critical-path-workflow"
  summary                 = "Workflow that calculates critical path"
  calculate_critical_path = true
}

# Workflow with skip handling
resource "stonebranch_task_workflow" "with_skip_handling" {
  name           = "tf-example-skip-workflow"
  summary        = "Workflow with custom skip behavior"
  skipped_option = "Skip Successors On Skip"
}

# Workflow with instance wait
resource "stonebranch_task_workflow" "with_instance_wait" {
  name                 = "tf-example-instance-wait-workflow"
  summary              = "Workflow that waits for other instances"
  instance_wait        = "Wait For All"
  instance_wait_lookup = "Oldest Instance"
}

# Workflow with retry configuration
resource "stonebranch_task_workflow" "with_retry" {
  name                    = "tf-example-retry-workflow"
  summary                 = "Workflow with retry settings"
  retry_maximum           = 3
  retry_interval          = 300
  retry_suppress_failure  = false
}

# Production workflow example
resource "stonebranch_task_workflow" "production" {
  name                    = "tf-example-production-workflow"
  summary                 = "Production data processing pipeline"
  calculate_critical_path = true
  skipped_option          = "Run Successors On Skip"
  layout_option           = "Vertical"

  retry_maximum  = 2
  retry_interval = 600
}

# Workflow with run_criteria referencing a task within it.
#
# Note: the Stonebranch API requires the referenced task to already exist as
# a vertex in the workflow before run_criteria can reference it, so the
# stonebranch_workflow_vertex resource must be applied before (or alongside,
# on a subsequent apply) the run_criteria that references it.
resource "stonebranch_task_unix" "step" {
  name       = "tf-example-workflow-step"
  agent_var  = var.agent_var
  command    = "echo step"
  exit_codes = "0"
}

resource "stonebranch_task_workflow" "with_run_criteria" {
  name    = "tf-example-run-criteria-workflow"
  summary = "Workflow with a Skip Criteria on one of its tasks"

  run_criteria = [
    {
      type         = "Skip Criteria"
      task         = stonebranch_task_unix.step.name
      business_day = true
    }
  ]
}

resource "stonebranch_workflow_vertex" "step" {
  workflow_name = stonebranch_task_workflow.with_run_criteria.name
  task_name     = stonebranch_task_unix.step.name
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Unique name of the workflow task.

### Optional

- `calculate_critical_path` (Boolean) Whether to calculate the critical path for the workflow.
- `calendar` (String) Name of the calendar to use for scheduling.
- `credentials` (String) Name of the credential to use for the workflow.
- `credentials_var` (String) Variable containing the credential name.
- `exclusive_tasks` (Attributes List) List of tasks that cannot run concurrently with this task. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--exclusive_tasks))
- `hold_resources` (Boolean) Whether to hold the task's virtual resources for the duration of any retries. Note: the Stonebranch API does not appear to persist this setting for workflow tasks; it is included here for schema consistency with other task types.
- `instance_wait` (String) Instance wait behavior. Valid values: 'None', 'Wait For Any', 'Wait For All'.
- `instance_wait_lookup` (String) How to look up instances for waiting. Valid values: 'Oldest Instance', 'Latest Instance'.
- `layout_option` (String) Layout option for the workflow diagram. Valid values: 'Vertical', 'Horizontal'.
- `opswise_groups` (List of String) List of business service names this workflow belongs to.
- `override_calendar` (Boolean) Whether to override the calendar settings of child tasks.
- `retry_indefinitely` (Boolean) Whether to retry indefinitely.
- `retry_interval` (Number) Interval between retries in seconds.
- `retry_maximum` (Number) Maximum number of retry attempts.
- `retry_suppress_failure` (Boolean) Whether to suppress failure after all retries are exhausted.
- `run_criteria` (Attributes List) List of Run/Skip Criteria that control whether a task within the workflow executes. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--run_criteria))
- `skipped_option` (String) Action to take when a task in the workflow is skipped. Valid values: 'Run Successors On Skip', 'Skip Successors On Skip', 'No Action'.
- `step_actions` (Attributes List) List of z/OS step actions (system operations) for the workflow. Rarely used outside z/OS environments. Only the core identification/target fields are modeled; additional mainframe-specific override fields are not currently supported. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--step_actions))
- `step_conditions` (Attributes List) List of z/OS step conditions for the workflow. Rarely used outside z/OS environments. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--step_conditions))
- `summary` (String) Summary/description of the workflow task.
- `variables` (Attributes List) List of task variables. These variables are scoped to the task and can be referenced using `${variable_name}` syntax. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--variables))
- `virtual_resources` (Attributes List) List of virtual resources consumed by this task during execution. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--virtual_resources))

### Read-Only

- `number_of_tasks` (Number) Number of tasks in the workflow (computed by server).
- `sys_id` (String) System ID of the task (assigned by StoneBranch).
- `version` (Number) Version number of the task (for optimistic locking).

<a id="nestedatt--exclusive_tasks"></a>
### Nested Schema for `exclusive_tasks`

Required:

- `task` (String) Name of the task that this task is mutually exclusive with.

Optional:

- `type` (String) Type of the exclusive-task relationship. Defaults to 'Direct' when not specified.


<a id="nestedatt--run_criteria"></a>
### Nested Schema for `run_criteria`

Required:

- `task` (String) Name of the task within the workflow that this criterion applies to.
- `type` (String) Criteria type. Valid values: 'Run Criteria', 'Skip Criteria'.

Optional:

- `business_day` (Boolean) Whether this criterion is based on a business day.
- `complex` (Boolean) Whether this criterion uses a complex (e.g. 'every Nth day of period') day expression.
- `complex_adjective` (String) Complex expression adjective (e.g. 'Every', 'First', 'Last').
- `complex_adjustment` (String) Complex expression adjustment type. Valid values: 'None', 'Before', 'After'.
- `complex_adjustment_amount` (Number) Number of adjustment units to apply for the complex adjustment.
- `complex_adjustment_type` (String) Unit of the complex adjustment (e.g. 'Day').
- `complex_noun` (String) Complex expression noun/unit (e.g. 'Day').
- `complex_nth_amount` (Number) The 'Nth' amount used in the complex expression.
- `complex_qualifier` (String) Complex expression qualifier/period (e.g. 'Year').
- `custom_day` (Boolean) Whether this criterion is based on a custom day.
- `custom_day_choice` (String) Name of the custom day (see `stonebranch_custom_day`) when custom_day is true.
- `description` (String) Description of the criterion.
- `evaluate_at` (String) When the variable comparison is evaluated. Valid values: 'Trigger Time', 'Vertex Time'.
- `holiday` (Boolean) Whether this criterion is based on a holiday.
- `holiday_adjustment` (String) Holiday adjustment type. Valid values: 'None', 'Before', 'After'.
- `holiday_adjustment_amount` (Number) Number of adjustment units to apply for the holiday adjustment.
- `holiday_adjustment_type` (String) Unit of the holiday adjustment (e.g. 'Day').
- `specific_day` (Boolean) Whether this criterion is based on specific days of the week.
- `specific_day_fri` (Boolean) Whether Friday is included when specific_day is true.
- `specific_day_mon` (Boolean) Whether Monday is included when specific_day is true.
- `specific_day_sat` (Boolean) Whether Saturday is included when specific_day is true.
- `specific_day_sun` (Boolean) Whether Sunday is included when specific_day is true.
- `specific_day_thu` (Boolean) Whether Thursday is included when specific_day is true.
- `specific_day_tue` (Boolean) Whether Tuesday is included when specific_day is true.
- `specific_day_wed` (Boolean) Whether Wednesday is included when specific_day is true.
- `variable` (Boolean) Whether this criterion is based on a variable comparison.
- `variable_name` (String) Name of the variable to compare when variable is true.
- `variable_op` (String) Comparison operator used when variable is true (e.g. '=', '!=').
- `variable_value` (String) Value to compare the variable against when variable is true.
- `vertex_id` (String) Identifier of the workflow vertex this criterion applies to. Defaults to 'Any'.


<a id="nestedatt--step_actions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `step_actions`

Optional:

- `agent` (String) Name of the agent to run the operation on.
- `agent_cluster` (String) Name of the agent cluster to run the operation on.
- `agent_cluster_var` (String) Variable containing the agent cluster name.
- `agent_var` (String) Variable containing the agent name.
- `description` (String) Description of the step action.
- `exec_criteria` (String) Execution criteria for the operation.
- `limit` (Number) Limit value associated with the operation.
- `notification_option` (String) Notification option for the operation.
- `operation` (String) Operation to perform (e.g. 'Launch Task').
- `program_name` (String) Name of the program executed by the step.
- `pstep_name` (String) Name of the procedure step (if any) this action applies to.
- `step_codes` (String) Condition/return codes that trigger this action.
- `step_name` (String) Name of the z/OS job step this action applies to.
- `task` (String) Name of the task to operate on.
- `trigger` (String) Name of the trigger to operate on.
- `vertex_id` (String) Identifier of the workflow vertex this step action applies to.


<a id="nestedatt--step_conditions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `step_conditions`

Optional:

- `program_name` (String) Name of the program executed by the step.
- `pstep_name` (String) Name of the procedure step (if any) this condition applies to.
- `step_action` (String) Action taken when the step condition is met.
- `step_codes` (String) Condition/return codes that this step condition checks for.
- `step_name` (String) Name of the z/OS job step this condition applies to.
- `step_order` (Number) Order of this step condition relative to others.
- `workflow_id` (String) Identifier of the workflow vertex this step condition applies to.


<a id="nestedatt--variables"></a>
### Nested Schema for `variables`

Required:

- `name` (String) Name of the variable.

Optional:

- `description` (String) Description of the variable.
- `value` (String) Value of the variable.


<a id="nestedatt--virtual_resources"></a>
### Nested Schema for `virtual_resources`

Optional:

- `amount` (Number) Amount of the virtual resource consumed by this task.
- `resource` (String) Name of the virtual resource consumed (see `stonebranch_virtual_resource`).
- `resource_var` (String) Variable containing the virtual resource name.
